capabilities: Play real-time writing sounds while drawing on Excalidraw canvases
Choose between pencil, fountain pen, and marker sound profiles
Adjust sound volume and tone pitch in settings
Preview sound profiles from the settings panel
disambiguation: Only adds sound feedback while drawing; it does not change Excalidraw drawing tools or strokes.
extras: Described as the official free standalone sound module of the Nuance productivity and performance ecosystem; the README covers BRAT and manual installation but no usage guide or troubleshooting.
problem: Digital handwriting on Excalidraw canvases is silent, lacking the acoustic feedback of writing on paper.

relations.evidence: Plays real-time scratching sounds as you draw on any Excalidraw canvas.

summary: Audio feedback plugin that plays pencil, fountain pen, or marker scratching sounds while you draw on Excalidraw canvases.
